waivers.match_regex: ^rtl/ot_session_table\.sv:[0-9]+: warning: @\* is sensitive to all [0-9]+ words in array 'entry_session'\.$
waivers.risk: An incomplete inferred sensitivity set could make simulation diverge from synthesized combinational lookup behavior.
waivers.rationale: Icarus 11 emits an informational expansion notice for an always-at-star block that reads every word of an unpacked array; it is not reporting an omitted element.
waivers.compensating_check: Strict Verilator lint is clean, Yosys check reports no structural problem, and stage integration plus session directed tests execute configure/lookup/retire behavior.
waivers.reentry_condition: Remove when the Icarus frontend no longer emits the expansion notice or the table implementation changes.

waivers.match_regex: ^rtl/ot_credit_manager\.sv:[0-9]+: warning: @\* is sensitive to all [0-9]+ words in array 'free'\.$
waivers.risk: An incomplete inferred sensitivity set could hide a credit update in simulation.
waivers.rationale: Icarus 11 is enumerating the unpacked-array sensitivity it did include; the message is not an omitted-sensitivity warning.
waivers.compensating_check: The credit manager passes Yosys SAT, CVC4 bounded proof and induction, independent Verilator randomized scoreboarding, and Yosys structural check.
waivers.reentry_condition: Remove when the Icarus frontend no longer emits the expansion notice or the credit storage representation changes.

waivers.match_regex: ^rtl/lib/ot_crc_pkg\.sv: excluded from Yosys 0\.9 structural elaboration because that frontend cannot parse SystemVerilog package functions$
waivers.scope: unused shared CRC package declaration only
waivers.risk: Yosys does not independently parse this helper package in the installed legacy release.
waivers.rationale: No synthesizable module imports the package; active CRC implementations are local functions/modules included in Yosys elaboration. Icarus and Verilator both parse the package.
waivers.compensating_check: Two independent language frontends parse the file, known-answer CRC tests cover the active implementations, and source scanning rejects package imports that would make the exclusion functional.
waivers.reentry_condition: Remove when Yosys is upgraded to a release that parses the package or when any synthesizable module imports ot_crc_pkg.
